name: progress-kpi-01
description: Progress to a monthly target, with the projected total hatched ahead of it and a line where an even pace would be by today.

files.content:
'use client' import { BlockReady, BlockStateProvider, type BlockStatus, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/block-state' import { KPI, KPIChange, KPIContent, KPITitle, type KPIFormat, KPIValue, getKPIFormatter, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/kpi' import { formatPercent } from '@/registry/lib/dashboardblocks/format' import { cn } from '@/lib/utils' interface ProgressKPI1Props { comparison: string daysElapsed: number daysInPeriod: number format?: KPIFormat previous?: number status?: BlockStatus target: number title: string /** Leave out to show the empty state. */ value?: number } const exampleProps: ProgressKPI1Props = { comparison: 'last month', daysElapsed: 18, daysInPeriod: 30, format: 'currency', previous: 81_400, target: 160_000, title: 'Revenue', value: 87_500, } const ProgressKPI1 = (props: ProgressKPI1Props) => { const { comparison, daysElapsed, daysInPeriod, format, previous, status, target, title, value, } = props const ready = status === undefined && value !== undefined const reached = ready ? value : 0 const formatter = getKPIFormatter(format) const share = target > 0 ? reached / target : 0 const expected = Math.min(100, (daysElapsed / daysInPeriod) * 100) const projected = daysElapsed > 0 ? (reached / daysElapsed) * daysInPeriod : reached const projectedShare = target > 0 ? Math.min(100, (projected / target) * 100) : 0 const gap = projected - target return ( {title}
{formatPercent(share, { maximumFractionDigits: 0 })} {' '} of {formatter(target)} Day {daysElapsed} of {daysInPeriod}

On pace for{' '} = 0 ? 'text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400' : 'text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400', )} > {formatter(projected)} , {formatter(Math.abs(gap))} {gap >= 0 ? 'over' : 'short of'} target. The hatched bar is the projection, the line an even pace.

) } export { ProgressKPI1, exampleProps as progressKpi1ExampleProps, type ProgressKPI1Props }
